definitions.success: Valid-document success means direct process_file returned a schema-shaped result with at least one invoice, no page errors and no failed/partial metadata status, not extraction correctness or job completion. Failures, including missing OCR and partial-page errors, stay in all valid denominators and receive no extraction credit. Known-corrupt cases are separate.
definitions.accuracy: Eight scalar fields scored on all expected invoice slots, including explicit nulls; unmatched extra predicted invoices add incorrect slots. Failed/missing invoices get zero correct, even for null labels. Exact compares JSON representations; normalized uses NFKC, whitespace/case, common dates and Decimal for numeric fields. No fuzzy credit.
definitions.alignment: Unique normalized invoice-number matches first, remaining invoices in source order. Line items align by row order, score description/quantity/unit_price/line_total and whole rows; extra or missing rows are incorrect slots.
definitions.ungrounded: Unsupported-value proxy = populated predicted scalar/item values absent from same-field ground truth anywhere in that document / all populated predicted scalar/item values on valid documents. Tests source-value support, not evidence-span validity or hallucination provenance; wrong attribution can evade it. Not an LLM metric.
definitions.review: False accept review = valid documents accepted with every predicted needs_review explicitly false despite a labeled missing/wrong-total issue OR an extraction mismatch / all valid documents with either condition (failed documents are not accepted). Labeled-only variant uses only labeled review-required documents. Manual review denominator is successful valid documents.
definitions.timing: Sequential per-document wall time including source reading (text layer or MinerU OCR), guardrail, model calls and grounding. Remote model latency depends on the gateway; documents served from the cache are counted in usage.cached_documents.
definitions.uncertainty: 95% Wilson binomial intervals on count rates. Small correlated synthetic format replicas/fields violate independence, so intervals are descriptive, not population guarantees. No latency confidence interval estimated.
definitions.scope: Train/dev/test families are seed-isolated before rendering; this runner processes test only and does not tune anything. Template/layout diversity is limited. Labels are generator-derived/self-checked, not independently human reviewed. Real samples, provider/LLM accuracy, reconciliation, cost and queue-load benchmarks remain pending; no downloads or fabricated metrics.
definitions.pipeline: AI pipeline: success means process_document returned at least one invoice without page errors. Every AI invoice carries needs_review=true by design, so false-accept rates are 0 by construction, not by detection quality.

sequential_throughput.label: Single-process sequential direct pipeline calls; no queue/API/concurrent load benchmark. Units are pages/sheets, not CSV rows.
